article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: WWII Treasury Broadcasts and Golden Age Classics Dated from Jack Benny, Fibber McGee, and The Shadow
article-meta.kwd-group: Jack Benny, Fibber McGee and Molly, The Shadow, WWII Homefront, Original Filenames, Primary Scans

sec.title: Batch 5 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 5 resolves 17 historical broadcasts spanning the wartime homefront campaigns and peak network comedy/mystery runs of ***The Jack Benny Program*** (Grape-Nuts Flakes & Lucky Strike runs), ***Fibber McGee and Molly*** (US Treasury War Bond drives & Johnson Wax broadcasts), and ***The Shadow*** (50th Anniversary documentary retrospective).

sec.title: 1. *Fibber McGee and Molly* — WWII War Loan Drives & Special Broadcasts Dated
sec.p: During World War II, Jim and Marian Jordan regularly dedicated closing segments and entire special broadcasts to War Bond recruitment and homefront rationing drives:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Historical Context & Sponsor | |---|---|---|---| | `Fibber_McGee_Give_Bonds_For_Christmas.mp3` | **"Give Bonds for Christmas (Pearl Harbor 2nd Anniversary)"** | **1943-12-07** | Aired on the second anniversary of Pearl Harbor; nationwide Treasury drive. | | `Fibber_McGee_Seventh_War_Loan_Drive.mp3` | **"Seventh War Loan Drive Special"** | **1945-05-15** | Post-V-E Day Seventh War Loan broadcast featuring Jim & Marian Jordan. | | `Fibber_McGee_Mileage_Rationing.mp3` | **"WWII Mileage Rationing Special"** | **1942-12-01** | Office of Price Administration (OPA) national gasoline and tire conservation broadcast. | | `Fibber_McGee_Buy_Defense_Bonds_And_Stamps.mp3` | **"Buy Defense Bonds and Stamps (Treasury Dept)"** | **1942-01-20** | First winter wartime Treasury Department broadcast following US entry into WWII. | | `Fibber_McGee_Send_Games_And_Reading_Material.mp3` | **"Send Games and Books to Troops (USO Special)"** | **1943-03-16** | Victory Book Campaign / USO serviceman recreation drive. | | `Fibber_McGee_Returning_From_Hollywood.mp3` | **"Returning from Hollywood (Johnson Wax)"** | **1944-03-21** | Regular Johnson Wax series episode following completion of RKO feature film *Heavenly Days*. |

sec.title: 3. *The Shadow* — 50th Anniversary Documentary
sec.list: - **Canonical Title**: **"The Story of The Shadow: 50th Anniversary Documentary"**
- **Forensic Audio Discovery**: Original announcer recounts the 1930s Street & Smith origin: *"Over 50 years ago, on the original radio program called The Shadow..."*
